notes.subject: ⟨em⟩
notes.rationale: Hebrew pronoun אתה fronted for emphasis; TP needs bracketed pronoun for the 'you are' sense

notes.subject: harim Gutpela tok
notes.rationale: gloss line included an extra imperative not in the Hebrew; the translation proper omits it

notes.subject: to Elohim/Yahwe
notes.rationale: direct plea to God: 'hurry to me', 'do not delay'

translation: Na mi, mi man lapun meri man nogut tru, mi no gat samting; Elohim, harim Gutpela tok na stat kwik kwik kam long mi; yu ⟨em⟩ help bilong mi na man i pulim mi auting long birua; yu ⟨em⟩, Yahwe, no ken streim taim.

na man i no gat moa samting
stat kwik kwik kam long mi
na man i pulim mi auting
